text:
net-bot: Alert: proxy ephemeral-port exhaustion pattern detected in eu-west-2 — multiple dedicated pools showing elevated `tcp_port_alloc_fail` and connection resets. Investigating.

Ravi: I see spikes on `proxy-03` and `proxy-07`. Top talker appears to be tenant X-77 (websocket embed clients) with frequent short-lived sockets.

Nora: Query: `topk(5, sum(rate(tcp_port_alloc_fail[1m])) by (tenant))` -> X-77 = 82/s, next = 3/s.

Theo: Root cause: proxy hosts running out of ephemeral ports -> socket drops -> router moves traffic to soft-slices which then thrash kvcache and CPU. Classic cascading fallback.

Ravi: Immediate mitigation: override routing for X-77 to `nat-headroom-eu-west-2` for 12m and enable a soft throttle `conn_rate_limit=800/s` on the tenant. Dry-run first.

ops-bot: Prepared dry-run: `routectl override --tenant=X-77 --to=nat-headroom-eu-west-2 --duration=12m --dry-run`. Approval needed.

Nora: Dry-run output: `plan ok; estimated shift 91% of X-77 egress; headroom_conn +15%; soft_slice_cpu +7%`.

Theo: Cost estimate ~0.25 GPU-hours ~ $1.50. Approve live. Also log INFRA-2401 for follow-up kernel tuning.

Ravi: Executing live override -> `override id=ovr-20260505-001 applied`. Monitoring `nat_port_free`, `conn_resets`, `soft_slice_cpu`.

Nora: +2m: `conn_resets` on proxy-03 down from 12% -> 0.6%. `nat_port_free` recovered. soft_slice_cpu +5%.

Theo: Post-fix actions: 1) contact X-77 PM to recommend connection reuse/multiplexing SDK patch; 2) add metric `tenant_ephemeral_share` and experiment auto-diversion when >60% for 2m; 3) staged kernel change to expand `ip_local_port_range` on proxy fleet.

Ravi: Override auto-rollback scheduled at 1721112888. No regressions so far. Will open INFRA-2401 and attach telemetry.

ops-bot: Rollback executed at 1721112888; override ovr-20260505-001 removed. Post-checks: stable. Thread closing.
